caption: Without any connected tool, the planning step turned our hand typed tasks into a day plan in about 1 minute 45 seconds, with start times and lengths per task. Some of our own test entries are hidden.
Public pricing has one paid plan: Pro at $17 a month billed yearly or $22 billed monthly. There is no free plan. A customer quote with a name is hidden.
The upgrade page inside the app shows the trial ending Thursday 3 December and $204 a year for Pro. We did not click Continue and no card field appeared.
The FAQ says nothing is charged because no card was asked, you lose access when the trial ends, and cancelled plans get no refunds or prorated credit. A customer photo is hidden.
The day view after Get started: planned tasks from 19:00 with a running timer, and the same blocks placed in the calendar column. Some of our own test entries are hidden.
